strings.name: Quoc Le
strings.summary: Quoc Le contributed to sequence-to-sequence learning, document vectors, neural architecture search and efficient image models through collaborative research. Formerly at Google, he co-founded Discovery Loop in 2026 with Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat and Oriol Vinyals.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Paper dates are first preprint submissions. Experimental results are distinguished from general capabilities; outdated Google current-role descriptions are not retained.
strings.influence.rationale: Advanced deep learning, neural architecture search and large language model research, helping apply research to global technology platforms.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: First Class Honours bachelor’s degree in Software Engineering, Australian National University; PhD in Computer Science, Stanford.
strings.facts.f2.label: Academic mentors
strings.facts.f2.value: Worked with Alex Smola as an undergraduate; doctoral advisor at Stanford was Andrew Ng.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Sequence and document representations
strings.highlights.h1.text: With collaborators, studied mapping sequences and documents to vectors for translation and text representation respectively.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Automated model design
strings.highlights.h2.text: Contributed to neural architecture search, EfficientNet and AutoML-Zero, exploring architecture selection, network scaling and learning-algorithm search.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Announces co-founding Discovery Loop
strings.timeline.t1.text: With Dean, Ghemawat and Vinyals, establishes a public benefit corporation aiming to automate scientific experiments.
strings.timeline.t2.title: First submission of chain-of-thought prompting paper
strings.timeline.t2.text: With Jason Wei and other authors, studies prompts containing intermediate-step examples to improve performance on selected reasoning tasks.
strings.timeline.t3.title: First submission of AutoML-Zero paper
strings.timeline.t3.text: With Esteban Real, Chen Liang and David R. So, explores evolutionary search for learning algorithms from basic mathematical operations.
strings.timeline.t4.title: First submission of EfficientNet paper
strings.timeline.t4.text: With Mingxing Tan, proposes coordinated scaling of convolutional network depth, width and image resolution.
strings.timeline.t5.title: First submission of neural architecture search paper
strings.timeline.t5.text: With Barret Zoph, uses a recurrent network to generate architectures and reinforcement learning to optimize validation performance.
strings.timeline.t6.title: First submission of sequence-to-sequence paper
strings.timeline.t6.text: With Ilya Sutskever and Oriol Vinyals, studies LSTM encoders and decoders in English–French translation experiments.
strings.timeline.t7.title: First submission of Paragraph Vector paper
strings.timeline.t7.text: With Tomas Mikolov, studies learning fixed-length vector representations from variable-length texts.
strings.timeline.t8.title: First submission of high-level feature learning paper
strings.timeline.t8.text: With Ranzato, Ng and other authors, studies feature learning from unlabeled images, observing detectors for faces and cat faces among other features.
